entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate physical spellbook modeling reference, not a runtime icon.
Input image is the PRIVATE original ICURS_BOOK_BLUE 88 for item.design.base.spellbook-blue. Use its actual book silhouette and colors; do not generate a generic ornate magic tome or individual spell edition.
Create a clean realistic HD turnaround sheet of ONE SAME CLOSED book in FRONT cover view, SIDE spine/thickness view, BACK rear-cover view and THREE-QUARTER view matching the source's closed-book angle, plus a small NEW HD inventory-composition thumbnail. Whole book visible, well separated on charcoal-gray backdrop, neutral soft studio light, restrained realistic leather/board/paper/metal texture. Only labels SPELLBOOK BLUE / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON.
Preserve the source identity: muted slate/indigo BLUE cover, thick rectangular closed binding, dark blue spine on the left bound edge, slightly raised/edged cover rim, worn pale-blue shallow horizontal embossed markings across the front center, ochre/pale cream page block, dull gold/brass corner protectors at the visible outer corners, and a narrow DARK RED ribbon bookmark hanging from the lower page edge. Not bright cobalt, not neon, not gold all over. The source front-center marks are indistinct texture/embossing: do not invent readable letters, spell names or a lightning symbol. The BACK and unseen corners are inferred; use a restrained plain matching blue back rather than inventing new magical decoration. Candidate materials are proposed from source colors, not recovered historical fact.
All views rotate the SAME volume with matching thickness, cover/page dimensions, spine attachment, protector geometry and red ribbon position/length. SIDE must be the genuine narrow bound-spine profile; BACK is the opposite cover and must place the spine/ribbon naturally. THREE-QUARTER and the small thumbnail show this same closed book and red marker, not a second design. Every inset is NEW realistic HD art, never source sprite pixels.
No open pages, floating pages, glow, gems, skulls, decorative chains, added clasps/cages, readable magic lettering, individual spell names, hands, scenery, alternate variants or source-pixel inset. This is only the blue physical cover family; it does not illustrate or letter every lightning spell.

reference.notes: Fonte: livro fechado azul-ardósia/índigo, lombada escura, cantos dourados, páginas ocres e marcador vermelho; marcas centrais indistintas. Referência 6x inspecionada antes da chamada; pixels originais não foram incorporados.

entries.variantScope: Uma família física de capa azul; as magias de raio permanecem variantes de dados, sem lettering individual.

Couro, papel e latão são interpretações materiais; o relevo não recupera letras originais.

coherenceReview.observed: Capa azul-ardósia, cantos dourados, páginas ocres, relevo abstrato e marcador vermelho preservados em FRONT/3-4/thumbnail; thumbnail HD novo.
pendingIssues: O marcador vermelho não aparece abaixo de BACK, embora apareça nas outras vistas; reconciliar a continuidade da mesma fita e sua posição antes de modelar.
Revisar espessura, cantos e nervuras entre SIDE e 3-4; o relevo gerado não é leitura recuperada da fonte.
Confirmar enquadramento/legibilidade no footprint lógico nativo, sem criar um livro por magia.

Create a clean realistic HD board of ONE SAME flask in FRONT, true SIDE, BACK and THREE-QUARTER views, plus a smaller NEW HD inventory-composition thumbnail of the same concept. Whole object visible, separated on plain charcoal-gray background, neutral soft studio light, enough soft gray reflection to read its dark silhouette. Only labels OIL FLASK / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON.
Preserve the original silhouette and palette: long narrow straight dark-gray neck, small short DARK RED/BURGUNDY stopper with a pale gray lip, sloping triangular/conical shoulders broadening into a LOW WIDE flattened-base body. The body is a compact rounded-triangular/conical flask, not a sphere, not a square medicinal vial. Nearly BLACK contents or dark smoky glass dominate the body; gray glass edges/base and subdued ordinary highlights define it. The source has NO visible rope wrap, gold collar, hanging cord or paper label: do not add these. Propose smoky glass, a red-brown stopper and very dark oily contents as material interpretations only; exact contents, wall thickness and hidden back are inferred. Keep the oil dark and non-emissive.
All views rotate one coherent flask with identical neck length, stopper, body/base shape, content height and thickness. SIDE is a genuine profile of its proposed volume; BACK and 3-4 show the same construction. ICON is newly rendered detailed realistic HD, never original pixel-art.
No labels or individual oil names, spell letters/runes, colored liquids, gold bands/cords, ornate cagework, gems, flames/glow, hands/characters, scenery, extra variants or pasted source sprite. This is ONE physical oil-family flask; ten named oil effects remain data/label variants and are not ten new bottles or ten individually lettered designs.
